description: Ministry of J ustice - Order made to apply the Provisions of Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction Act, No. 10 of 2001 on Russian Federation & South Korea
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that specifies the countries to which the Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction Act applies. It involves the exercise of statutory powers under an existing Act (No. 10 of 2001) to make a legal specification, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
